title: Transparency
subtitle: PonyLife operates in the open. Clear principles, public infrastructure, and versioned changes.

sections.heading: Core principles
sections.body: No fiduciary responsibility. No custody of user funds. No financial guarantees. No outcome optimization.

sections.heading: Public infrastructure
sections.body: Smart contract verification and on-chain activity are publicly visible. The platform is a coordination layer.

sections.heading: Change log
sections.body: Material changes to rules, structure, or participation logic are documented. Clarity beats hype.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: PonyLife is an experiment. It is not a fund, not a financial product, and not an investment platform.
